sect2.title: Introduction to SQLite
sect2.para: The SQLite package is a software library that implements a self-contained, serverless, zero-configuration, transactional SQL database engine. This package is required by Firefox.

sect2.title: Installation of SQLite
sect2.para: Install SQLite by running the following commands:

screen.userinput: ./configure --prefix=/usr \ --disable-static \ --enable-fts{4,5} \ CPPFLAGS="-D SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA=1 \ -D SQLITE_ENABLE_UNLOCK_NOTIFY=1 \ -D SQLITE_ENABLE_DBSTAT_VTAB=1 \ -D SQLITE_SECURE_DELETE=1" && make

sect1.sect2:
Command Explanations
&static-libraries;
--enable-fts{4,5}: These switches enable support for version 4 and 5 of the full text search (FTS) extension.
CPPFLAGS="-D SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA=1 ... : Some applications require these options to be turned on. The only way to do this is to include them in the CFLAGS or CPPFLAGS. We use the latter so the default value (or any value set by the user) of CFLAGS won't be affected. For further information on what can be specified see .
